claim_ceiling: S3c implementation-choice record only; no environment-validity, baseline-power, gap, headroom, mechanism, learning-capability, agency, or EGO claim

candidates.description: Implement lightweight empirical next-symbol predictors that expose the five frozen member names but avoid real framework fitting.
candidates.evidence_it_would_produce: Fast interface tests and prediction-format artifacts.
candidates.strongest_cheap_baseline_that_could_matc: global_prior or action-conditioned count tables could match the emitted distributions under identical access.
candidates.leakage_or_hardcoding_risk: High: would under-implement the frozen logreg, GBT, and GRU grids and create a pass-shaped local module without the required tuning evidence.
candidates.smallest_falsifying_test: Assert per-config tuning report contains all frozen grid entries with framework names, selected configs, and internal-validation metrics from callable fit paths.
candidates.expected_failure_mode: Instrument invalid as underpowered baseline implementation.

candidates.description: Fit action-conditioned empirical lookup/count baselines over the pooled train partitions and persist those as recipes for the S3c names.
candidates.evidence_it_would_produce: High-speed next-symbol predictions and deterministic recipe artifacts.
candidates.strongest_cheap_baseline_that_could_matc: The shortcut is itself the cheap baseline; it would not test whether the declared decoder and sequence framework families were available or budgeted.
candidates.leakage_or_hardcoding_risk: Medium: can stay prefix-only but silently replaces the frozen model classes and hides framework capability failures.
candidates.smallest_falsifying_test: Inspect persisted model metadata and tuning report for declared framework class, exact grid config id, and member-specific feature/action-conditioning convention.
candidates.expected_failure_mode: S3c invalid because frozen members were substituted after governance repair.

candidates.description: Implement PrefixOnlyPredictor-compatible feature pipelines for the three decoder members and two sequence members, run the frozen grids on train-fit users only, select by internal-validation users only, and persist models or deterministic recipes per the addendum.
candidates.evidence_it_would_produce: Callable member classes, contract tests for heldout exclusion/action invariance/W15 boundary reset, compute projection, tuning report, manifest, model or recipe hashes.
candidates.strongest_cheap_baseline_that_could_matc: Action-local empirical predictors may match later S3d scores, but S3c does not adjudicate baseline power; it only creates the declared fair-battery members.
candidates.leakage_or_hardcoding_risk: Moderate: heldout leakage, accidental action features in the no-action member, cross-session persistence in W15, and hidden simulator imports are the main risks.
candidates.smallest_falsifying_test: Run S3c tests plus the sealing import-graph test and verify all tuning examples are drawn from user_id 0..799 with validation restricted to 640..799.
candidates.expected_failure_mode: Projection can exceed 24 CPU-hours; if so the frozen stop condition fires before the sweep.

selection_reason: Only this route implements the frozen S3c addendum without substituting cheaper baseline logic or broadening the claim.
stop_condition: If PART 0 projection is greater than 24 CPU-hours, stop and write a preserved failure manifest instead of launching the sweep.
forbidden_changes: No edits to the five frozen source files.
No edits to S3a/S3b files or prior manifests.
No heldout access during S3c fitting, tuning, early stopping, or model selection.
